title: vader.json
description: A Vader project: the programs built from its folder, where their modules are found, and the files copied beside the binaries.

name.description: The project's name, for its reader: the compiler does not use it.

version.description: The project's version, for its reader: the compiler does not use it.

includePaths.description: Extra module search roots, each a folder relative to the project, or under the toolchain's folder when it starts with $VADER_HOME.

entries.description: The programs the project builds: each binary's name mapped to its entry file, relative to the project.

assets.description: Files and folders copied beside the binaries, each relative to the project and inside it.
